service should return.
Read more about custom scripts in our [tutorials](${ tutorial }) or use already prepared scripts
for different collections from the [custom script repository](${ repo }).

tjenesten skal returnere.
Læs mere om brugerdefinerede scripts i vores [vejledninger](${ tutorial }), eller brug allerede forberedte scripts
til forskellige kollektioner fra [arkivet med brugerdefinerede scripts](${ repo }).

# SLSTR VIS/SWIR Bands (S1–S6)\n\nSentin.msgid:
# SLSTR VIS/SWIR Bands (S1–S6)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) captures Top-of-Atmosphere radiances in six solar reflective channels at 500 m resolution: S1 (0.555 µm, vegetation/aerosol), S2 (0.659 µm, NDVI/aerosol), S3 (0.865 µm, NDVI/cloud flagging), S4 (1.375 µm, cirrus detection), S5 (1.61 µm, ice/snow/vegetation), and S6 (2.25 µm, vegetation state). Each band is available in nadir and oblique views, enabling dual-angle observation of land and ocean surfaces. The L1B product contains geolocated, calibrated radiances produced by signal calibration, re-gridding, and cloud flagging.



More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).
msgstr:
# SLSTR VIS/SWIR-bånd (S1–S6)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) opfanger radiansen i toppen af atmosfæren i seks solreflekterende kanaler ved 500 m opløsning: S1 (0,555 µm, vegetation/aerosol), S2 (0,659 µm, NDVI/aerosol), S3 (0,865 µm, NDVI/skymarkering), S4 (1,375 µm, cirrusdetektion), S5 (1,61 µm, is/sne/vegetation) og S6 (2,25 µm, vegetationstilstand). Hvert bånd er tilgængeligt i nadir- og skrå visning, hvilket muliggør observation af land- og havoverflader i to vinkler. L1B-produktet indeholder geolokaliseret, kalibreret radians frembragt ved signalkalibrering, omgitring og skymarkering.



Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).

# SLSTR Thermal Infrared Bands (S7–S9)\n.msgid:
# SLSTR Thermal Infrared Bands (S7–S9)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) captures Top-of-Atmosphere brightness temperatures in three thermal infrared channels at 1 km resolution: S7 (3.74 µm, sea/land surface temperature and fire detection), S8 (10.85 µm, sea/land surface temperature and fire detection), and S9 (12.0 µm, sea/land surface temperature). Each band is available in nadir and oblique views, enabling dual-angle observation for improved atmospheric correction and surface temperature retrieval. The L1B product contains geolocated, calibrated brightness temperatures produced by signal calibration, re-gridding, and cloud flagging.



More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).
msgstr:
# SLSTR termiske infrarøde bånd (S7–S9)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) opfanger lysstyrketemperaturer i toppen af atmosfæren i tre termiske infrarøde kanaler ved 1 km opløsning: S7 (3,74 µm, hav-/landoverfladetemperatur og branddetektion), S8 (10,85 µm, hav-/landoverfladetemperatur og branddetektion) og S9 (12,0 µm, hav-/landoverfladetemperatur). Hvert bånd er tilgængeligt i nadir- og skrå visning, hvilket muliggør observation i to vinkler for forbedret atmosfærekorrektion og udledning af overfladetemperatur. L1B-produktet indeholder geolokaliserede, kalibrerede lysstyrketemperaturer frembragt ved signalkalibrering, omgitring og skymarkering.



Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).

# Thermal IR fire emission bands\n\nSent.msgid:
# Thermal IR fire emission bands

Sentinel-3 Sea and Land Surface Temperature Instrument (SLSTR) has two dedicated channels (F1 and F2) that aim to detect Land Surface Temperature (LST). F2 Channel, with a central wavelength of 10854 nm measures in the thermal infrared, or TIR. It is very useful for fire and high temperature event monitoring at 1 km resolution.



More info [here.](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/user-guides/sentinel-3-slstr/overview/geophysical-measurements/land-surface-temperature)
msgstr:
# Termiske IR-brandemissionsbånd

Sentinel-3 Sea and Land Surface Temperature Instrument (SLSTR) har to dedikerede kanaler (F1 og F2), der har til formål at registrere landoverfladetemperatur (LST). Kanal F2 med en central bølgelængde på 10854 nm måler i det termiske infrarøde, eller TIR. Den er meget nyttig til overvågning af brande og højtemperaturhændelser ved 1 km opløsning.



Mere info [her.](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/user-guides/sentinel-3-slstr/overview/geophysical-measurements/land-surface-temperature)

# Effective radiometric cloud fraction\n.msgid:
# Effective radiometric cloud fraction

Effective radiometric cloud fraction represents the portion of the Earth's surface covered by clouds, divided by the total surface. Clouds have shielding, albedo, and in-cloud absorption effects on trace gas retrieval. The effective radiometric cloud fraction is an important parameter to correct these effects.
msgstr:
# Effektiv radiometrisk skydækningsgrad

Den effektive radiometriske skydækningsgrad angiver den del af Jordens overflade, der er dækket af skyer, divideret med den samlede overflade. Skyer har afskærmnings-, albedo- og absorptionseffekter i skyen på bestemmelsen af sporgasser. Den effektive radiometriske skydækningsgrad er en vigtig parameter til at korrigere for disse effekter.

# Cloud optical thickness\n\nThe cloud t.msgid:
# Cloud optical thickness

The cloud thickness is a key parameter to characterise optical properties of clouds. It is a measure of how much sunlight passes through the cloud to reach Earth's surface. The higher a cloud's optical thickness, the more sunlight the cloud is scattering and reflecting. Dark blue shows where there are low cloud optical thickness values and red shows larger cloud optical thickness.
msgstr:
# Skyens optiske tykkelse

Skytykkelsen er en nøgleparameter til at karakterisere skyers optiske egenskaber. Den er et mål for, hvor meget sollys der passerer gennem skyen og når Jordens overflade. Jo højere en skys optiske tykkelse er, desto mere sollys spreder og reflekterer skyen. Mørkeblå viser, hvor der er lave værdier for skyens optiske tykkelse, og rød viser større optisk tykkelse.

# Thermal band 10\n\nThis thermal visual.msgid:
# Thermal band 10

This thermal visualization is based on band 10 (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). At the central wavelength of 10895 nm it measures in the thermal infrared, or TIR. Instead of measuring the temperature of the air, like weather stations do, band 10 reports on the ground itself, which is often much hotter. Thermal band 10 is useful in providing surface temperatures and is collected with a 100-meter resolution.



More info [here](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-are-band-designations-landsat-satellites?qt-news_science_products=0#qt-news_science_products).
msgstr:
# Termisk bånd 10

Denne termiske visualisering er baseret på bånd 10 (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd). Ved den centrale bølgelængde på 10895 nm måler det i det termiske infrarøde, eller TIR. I stedet for at måle luftens temperatur, som vejrstationer gør, rapporterer bånd 10 om selve jorden, som ofte er meget varmere. Termisk bånd 10 er nyttigt til at give overfladetemperaturer og indsamles med en opløsning på 100 meter.



Mere info [her](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-are-band-designations-landsat-satellites?qt-news_science_products=0#qt-news_science_products).

# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

The normalized difference vegetation index is a simple, but effective index for quantifying green vegetation. It is a measure of the state of vegetation health based on how plants reflect light at certain wavelengths. The value range of the NDVI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDVI (values approaching -1) correspond to water. Values close to zero (-0.1to 0.1) generally correspond to barren areas of rock, sand, or snow. Low, positive values represent shrub and grassland (approximately 0.2 to 0.4), while high values indicate temperate and tropical rainforests (values approaching 1).

More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndvi/).
msgstr:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

Det normaliserede differensvegetationsindeks er et enkelt, men effektivt indeks til kvantificering af grøn vegetation. Det er et mål for vegetationens sundhedstilstand baseret på, hvordan planter reflekterer lys ved bestemte bølgelængder. NDVI's værdiinterval er -1 til 1. Negative NDVI-værdier (værdier nær -1) svarer til vand. Værdier tæt på nul (-0,1 til 0,1) svarer generelt til golde områder med klippe, sand eller sne. Lave, positive værdier repræsenterer krat og græsland (ca. 0,2 til 0,4), mens høje værdier indikerer tempererede og tropiske regnskove (værdier nær 1).

Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndvi/).

# Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)\n\nThe.msgid:
# Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)

The enhanced vegetation index (EVI) is an 'optimized' vegetation index as it corrects for soil background signals and atmospheric influences. It is very useful in areas of dense canopy cover. The range of values for EVI is -1 to 1, with healthy vegetation generally around 0.20 to 0.80.





More infos [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/evi/) and [here.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enhanced_vegetation_index)
msgstr:
# Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)

Det forbedrede vegetationsindeks (EVI) er et 'optimeret' vegetationsindeks, da det korrigerer for jordbundssignaler og atmosfæriske påvirkninger. Det er meget nyttigt i områder med tæt kronedække. Værdiintervallet for EVI er -1 til 1, hvor sund vegetation generelt ligger omkring 0,20 til 0,80.





Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/evi/) og [her.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enhanced_vegetation_index)

# Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation I.msgid:
# Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index (ARVI)

The Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index (ARVI) is a vegetation index that minimizes the effects of atmospheric scattering. It is most useful for regions with high content of atmospheric aerosol (fog, dust, smoke, air pollution). The range for an ARVI is -1 to 1 where green vegetation generally falls between values of 0.20 to 0.80.





More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/arvi/) and [here.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)
msgstr:
# Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index (ARVI)

Det atmosfærisk modstandsdygtige vegetationsindeks (ARVI) er et vegetationsindeks, der minimerer virkningerne af atmosfærisk spredning. Det er mest nyttigt i regioner med højt indhold af atmosfærisk aerosol (tåge, støv, røg, luftforurening). Intervallet for ARVI er -1 til 1, hvor grøn vegetation generelt ligger mellem værdierne 0,20 og 0,80.





Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/arvi/) og [her.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)

# Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)\.msgid:
# Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)

The Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index is similar to Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) but is used in areas where vegetative cover is low (< 40%). The index is a transformation technique that minimizes soil brightness influences from spectral vegetation indices involving red and near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths. The index is helpful when analysing young crops, arid regions with sparse vegetation and exposed soil surfaces.





More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/savi/) and [here.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)
msgstr:
# Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)

Det jordjusterede vegetationsindeks ligner Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), men bruges i områder med lavt vegetationsdække (< 40 %). Indekset er en transformationsteknik, der minimerer indflydelsen fra jordens lysstyrke i spektrale vegetationsindeks, der involverer røde og nær-infrarøde (NIR) bølgelængder. Indekset er nyttigt ved analyse af unge afgrøder, tørre egne med spredt vegetation og blottede jordoverflader.





Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/savi/) og [her.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)

# Modified Anthocyanin Reflectance Index.msgid:
# Modified Anthocyanin Reflectance Index (mARI/ARI2)

Anthocyanins are pigments common in higher plants, causing their red, blue and purple coloration. They provide valuable information about the physiological status of plants, as they are considered indicators of various types of plant stresses. The reflectance of anthocyanin is highest around 550nm. However, the same wavelengths are reflected by chlorophyll as well. To isolate the anthocyanins, the 700nm spectral band, that reflects only chlorophyll and not anthocyanins, is subtracted.

To correct for leaf density and thickness, the near infrared spectral band (in the recommended wavelengths of 760-800nm), which is related to leaf scattering, is added to the basic ARI index. The new index is called modified ARI or mARI (also ARI2).

mARI values for the examined trees in [this original article](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/mari/) ranged in values from 0 to 8.





More info [here.](https://digitalcommons.unl.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1227&context=natrespapers)
msgstr:
# Modified Anthocyanin Reflectance Index (mARI/ARI2)

Anthocyaniner er pigmenter, der er almindelige i højere planter, og som giver dem deres røde, blå og lilla farve. De giver værdifuld information om planters fysiologiske tilstand, da de betragtes som indikatorer for forskellige typer plantestress. Anthocyaniners reflektans er højest omkring 550 nm. Samme bølgelængder reflekteres dog også af klorofyl. For at isolere anthocyaninerne trækkes 700 nm-spektralbåndet, der kun reflekterer klorofyl og ikke anthocyaniner, fra.

For at korrigere for bladtæthed og -tykkelse lægges det nær-infrarøde spektralbånd (ved de anbefalede bølgelængder på 760-800 nm), som er relateret til bladspredning, til det grundlæggende ARI-indeks. Det nye indeks kaldes modificeret ARI eller mARI (også ARI2).

mARI-værdierne for de undersøgte træer i [denne originale artikel](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/mari/) lå i intervallet 0 til 8.





Mere info [her.](https://digitalcommons.unl.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1227&context=natrespapers)

# Green City Script\n\nThe Green city sc.msgid:
# Green City Script

The Green city script aims to raise awareness of green areas in cities around the world. The script takes into account the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and true color wavelengths; it separates built up areas from vegetated ones, making it useful for detecting urban areas. Built up areas are displayed in grey and vegetation is displayed in green.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/green_city/)
msgstr:
# Green City Script

Green city-scriptet har til formål at øge bevidstheden om grønne områder i byer rundt om i verden. Scriptet tager højde for Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) og bølgelængder for naturtro farver; det adskiller bebyggede områder fra beplantede og er derfor nyttigt til at registrere byområder. Bebyggede områder vises i gråt, og vegetation vises i grønt.





Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/green_city/)

# Urban Classified Script\n\nThe Urban C.msgid:
# Urban Classified Script

The Urban Classified script aims to detect built up areas by separating them from barren ground, vegetation and water. Areas with a high moisture content are returned in blue; areas indicating built up areas are returned in white; vegetated areas are returned in green; everything else indicates barren ground and is displayed in brown colors.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_classified/)
msgstr:
# Urban Classified Script

Urban Classified-scriptet har til formål at registrere bebyggede områder ved at adskille dem fra bar jord, vegetation og vand. Områder med højt fugtindhold returneres i blåt; områder, der angiver bebyggelse, returneres i hvidt; beplantede områder returneres i grønt; alt andet angiver bar jord og vises i brune farver.





Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_classified/)

This script, made by Leo Tolari, combines true color visualization with near infrared (NIR) and shortwave infrared (SWIR) wavelengths. The script highlights urban areas better than true color, while still looking natural.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_land_infrared/)

Dette script, lavet af Leo Tolari, kombinerer visualisering i naturtro farver med nær-infrarøde (NIR) og kortbølgede infrarøde (SWIR) bølgelængder. Scriptet fremhæver byområder bedre end naturtro farver, mens det stadig ser naturligt ud.





Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/urban_land_infrared/)

# NDMI for Moisture Stress\n\nThe Normal.msgid:
# NDMI for Moisture Stress

The Normalized Difference Moisture Index (NDMI) for moisture stress can be used to detect irrigation. For all the index values above 0, knowing the land use and land cover, it is possible to determine whether irrigation has taken place. Knowing the type of crop grown (e.g. citrus crops), it is possible to identify whether irrigation is being effective or not during the crucial growing summer season, as well as find out if some parts of the farm are being under or over-irrigated.





More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi_special/#)
msgstr:
# NDMI for Moisture Stress

Normalized Difference Moisture Index (NDMI) for fugtstress kan bruges til at registrere kunstvanding. For alle indeksværdier over 0 er det, når man kender arealanvendelsen og arealdækket, muligt at afgøre, om der har fundet kunstvanding sted. Når man kender den dyrkede afgrødetype (f.eks. citrusafgrøder), er det muligt at identificere, om kunstvandingen er effektiv i den afgørende vækstsæson om sommeren, samt at finde ud af, om dele af gården er under- eller overvandet.





Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi_special/#)

# Normalized Difference Moisture Index (.msgid:

The normalized difference moisture Index (NDMI) is used to determine vegetation water content and monitor droughts. The value range of the NDMI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDMI (values approaching -1) correspond to barren soil. Values around zero (-0.2 to 0.4) generally correspond to water stress. High, positive values represent high canopy without water stress (approximately 0.4 to 1).



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi/)
msgstr:
# Normalized Difference Moisture Index (NDMI)

Det normaliserede differensfugtindeks (NDMI) bruges til at bestemme vegetationens vandindhold og overvåge tørke. NDMI's værdiinterval er -1 til 1. Høje, positive værdier repræsenterer tæt kronedække uden vandstress (ca. 0,4 til 1).



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndmi/)

# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDW.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI)

The normalized difference water index is most appropriate for water body mapping. Values of water bodies are larger than 0.5. Vegetation has smaller values. Built-up features have positive values between zero and 0.2.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndwi/)
msgstr:

Det normaliserede differensvandindeks er mest velegnet til kortlægning af vandområder. Værdier for vandområder er større end 0,5. Vegetation har mindre værdier. Bebyggede elementer har positive værdier mellem nul og 0,2.

# False color composite\n\nA false color.msgid:
# False color composite

A false color composite uses at least one non-visible wavelength to image Earth. The false color composite using near infrared, red and green bands is very popular (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). The false colour composite is most commonly used to assess plant density and health, since plants reflect near infrared and green light, while they absorb red. Cities and exposed ground are grey or tan, and water appears blue or black.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/) and [here.](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites)

Den falske farvekomposit bruges oftest til at vurdere plantetæthed og -sundhed, da planter reflekterer nær-infrarødt og grønt lys, mens de absorberer rødt. Byer og blottet jord er grå eller lysebrune, og vand fremstår blåt eller sort.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/) og [her.](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites)

# True color optimized\n\nThis optimized.msgid:
# True color optimized

This optimized True color script uses the visible light bands red, green and blue in the corresponding red, green and blue color channels, resulting in a product with natural colours that represents the Earth as humans would naturally see it. The visualisation uses highlight compression and improves the contrast and color vividness through minor contrast and saturation enhancement.



More info for [L1C](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/l1c_optimized/) and for [L2A](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/l2a_optimized/).

# Tristimulus\n\nThe colours of natural.msgid:
# Tristimulus

The colours of natural waters differ markedly across the globe, depending on water composition and illumination conditions. Ocean colour instruments measure water-leaving radiance in narrow spectral bands to retrieve water-quality indicators. The true colour of natural waters is derived by calculating tristimulus values — the three primaries (X, Y, Z) that specify a colour stimulus as perceived by the human eye.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/tristimulus/).
msgstr:
# Tristimulus

Farverne på naturligt vand varierer markant rundt om på kloden, afhængigt af vandets sammensætning og belysningsforholdene. Instrumenter til havfarve måler det udgående vandlys i smalle spektralbånd for at udlede vandkvalitetsindikatorer. Naturligt vands sande farve udledes ved at beregne tristimulusværdier — de tre primærfarver (X, Y, Z), der specificerer en farvestimulus, som den opfattes af det menneskelige øje.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/tristimulus/).

# RGB (B17, B05, B02)\n\nThis false colo.msgid:
# RGB (B17, B05, B02)

This false color composite maps Sentinel-3 OLCI bands B17 (865 nm, near-infrared), B05 (510 nm, cyan-green), and B02 (412.5 nm, violet) into the red, green, and blue display channels respectively. B17 is a near-infrared band used for aerosol and atmospheric correction; placing it in the red channel makes vegetation and land surfaces appear bright red while water remains dark. B05 is sensitive to chlorophyll, sediment, turbidity, and red tide, and B02 captures yellow dissolved organic matter (CDOM) and detrital pigments. The composite is useful for ocean colour analysis, coastal water quality monitoring, and distinguishing turbid or sediment-laden waters from clear ocean.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).
msgstr:
# RGB (B17, B05, B02)

Denne falske farvekomposit kortlægger Sentinel-3 OLCI-båndene B17 (865 nm, nær-infrarød), B05 (510 nm, cyangrøn) og B02 (412,5 nm, violet) til henholdsvis den røde, grønne og blå visningskanal. B17 er et nær-infrarødt bånd, der bruges til aerosol- og atmosfærekorrektion; når det placeres i den røde kanal, fremstår vegetation og landoverflader klart røde, mens vand forbliver mørkt. B05 er følsomt over for klorofyl, sediment, uklarhed og rødt tidevand, og B02 opfanger gult opløst organisk stof (CDOM) og detritale pigmenter. Kompositten er nyttig til analyse af havfarve, overvågning af vandkvalitet i kystvande og til at skelne uklart eller sedimentrigt vand fra klart hav.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).

# RGB (B17, B06, B03)\n\nThis false colo.msgid:
# RGB (B17, B06, B03)

This false color composite maps Sentinel-3 OLCI bands B17 (865 nm, near-infrared), B06 (560 nm, green), and B03 (442.5 nm, blue) into the red, green, and blue display channels respectively. B17 is a near-infrared band used for aerosol and atmospheric correction; placing it in the red channel makes vegetation and land surfaces appear bright red while water remains dark. B06 is the chlorophyll absorption minimum reference band, and B03 captures chlorophyll absorption and biogeochemical properties. Compared to the B17/B05/B02 composite, the shifted green and blue channels offer a different sensitivity to phytoplankton and dissolved organic matter in coastal and open ocean waters.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).
msgstr:
# RGB (B17, B06, B03)

Denne falske farvekomposit kortlægger Sentinel-3 OLCI-båndene B17 (865 nm, nær-infrarød), B06 (560 nm, grøn) og B03 (442,5 nm, blå) til henholdsvis den røde, grønne og blå visningskanal. B17 er et nær-infrarødt bånd, der bruges til aerosol- og atmosfærekorrektion; når det placeres i den røde kanal, fremstår vegetation og landoverflader klart røde, mens vand forbliver mørkt. B06 er referencebåndet for klorofylabsorptionens minimum, og B03 opfanger klorofylabsorption og biogeokemiske egenskaber. Sammenlignet med B17/B05/B02-kompositten giver de forskudte grønne og blå kanaler en anden følsomhed over for fytoplankton og opløst organisk stof i kystvande og åbent hav.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).

# Enhanced True Color Visualization\n\nT.msgid:
# Enhanced True Color Visualization

This script uses highlight optimization to avoid burnt out pixels and to even out the exposure. It makes clouds look natural and keep as much visual information as possible. Sentinel-3 OLCI tiles cover large areas, making it possible to observe large cloud formations, such as hurricanes.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/true_color_highlight_optimized/)
msgstr:
# Forbedret visualisering i naturtro farver

Dette script bruger optimering af højlys for at undgå udbrændte pixels og udjævne eksponeringen. Det får skyer til at se naturlige ud og bevarer så megen visuel information som muligt. Sentinel-3 OLCI-felter dækker store områder, hvilket gør det muligt at observere store skyformationer, såsom orkaner.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/true_color_highlight_optimized/)

# Pansharpened True Color\n\nThe panshar.msgid:
# Pansharpened True Color

The pansharpened true color composite is done by using the usual true color data (red, green and blue (RGB)) and enhancing them by using the panchromatic band 8, or pan band (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). An image from the pan band is similar to black-and-white film: it combines light from the red, green, and blue parts of the spectrum into a single measure of overall visible reflectance. Pansharpened images have 4x the resolution of the usual true color composite, greatly enhancing the usefulness of Landsat imagery.



More info [here](https://blog.mapbox.com/pansharpening-for-higher-resolution-in-landsat-live-e4717cd7c356).
msgstr:
# Pansharpened naturtro farver

Den pansharpened naturtro farvekomposit fremstilles ved at bruge de sædvanlige data i naturtro farver (rød, grøn og blå (RGB)) og forbedre dem ved hjælp af det pankromatiske bånd 8, eller pan-båndet (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd). Et billede fra pan-båndet ligner sort-hvid film: det kombinerer lys fra de røde, grønne og blå dele af spektret til ét enkelt mål for den samlede synlige reflektans. Pansharpened billeder har 4 gange opløsningen af den sædvanlige naturtro farvekomposit, hvilket i høj grad øger anvendeligheden af Landsat-billeder.



Mere info [her](https://blog.mapbox.com/pansharpening-for-higher-resolution-in-landsat-live-e4717cd7c356).

# False Color Urban composite\n\nThis co.msgid:
# False Color Urban composite

This composite is used to visualise urbanized areas more clearly. Vegetation is visible in shades of green, while urbanized areas are represented by white, grey, or purple. Soils, sand, and minerals are shown in a variety of colors. Snow and ice appear as dark blue, and water as black or blue. Flooded areas are very dark blue and almost black. The composite is useful for detecting wildfires and calderas of volcanoes, as they are displayed in shades of red and yellow.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false-color-urban-rgb/) and [here.](https://eos.com/false-color/)
msgstr:
# Falsk farvekomposit for byområder

Denne komposit bruges til at visualisere urbaniserede områder tydeligere. Vegetation er synlig i nuancer af grønt, mens urbaniserede områder repræsenteres af hvidt, gråt eller lilla. Jord, sand og mineraler vises i en række farver. Sne og is fremstår mørkeblå og vand sort eller blåt. Oversvømmede områder er meget mørkeblå og næsten sorte. Kompositten er nyttig til at registrere skovbrande og vulkankalderaer, da de vises i nuancer af rødt og gult.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false-color-urban-rgb/) og [her.](https://eos.com/false-color/)

# Agriculture composite\n\nThis composit.msgid:
# Agriculture composite

This composite uses short-wave infrared, near-infrared and blue bands to monitor crop health (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Both short-wave and near infrared bands are particularly good at highlighting dense vegetation, which appears dark green in the composite. Crops appear in a vibrant green and bare earth appears magenta.



More info [here](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites) and [here.](https://gisgeography.com/sentinel-2-bands-combinations/)
msgstr:
# Landbrugskomposit

Denne komposit bruger kortbølgede infrarøde, nær-infrarøde og blå bånd til at overvåge afgrødesundhed (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd). Både kortbølgede og nær-infrarøde bånd er særligt gode til at fremhæve tæt vegetation, som fremstår mørkegrøn i kompositten. Afgrøder fremstår i en levende grøn farve, og bar jord fremstår magenta.



Mere info [her](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites) og [her.](https://gisgeography.com/sentinel-2-bands-combinations/)

# Snow Classifier\n\nThe Snow Classifier.msgid:
# Snow Classifier

The Snow Classifier algorithm aims to detect snow by classifying pixels based on different brightness and Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) thresholds. Values classified as snow are returned in bright vivid blue. The script can overestimate snow areas over clouds.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/snow_classifier/)
msgstr:
# Snow Classifier

Snow Classifier-algoritmen har til formål at registrere sne ved at klassificere pixels ud fra forskellige tærskler for lysstyrke og Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI). Værdier, der klassificeres som sne, returneres i klar, levende blå. Scriptet kan overvurdere snearealer over skyer.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/snow_classifier/)

# Ulyssys Water Quality Viewer (UWQV)\n\.msgid:
# Ulyssys Water Quality Viewer (UWQV)

The script aims to dynamically visualise the chlorophyll and sediment conditions of water bodies, which are primary indicators of water quality. The chlorophyll content ranges in colors from dark blue (low chlorophyll content) through green to red (high chlorophyll content). Sediment concentrations are colored brown; opaque brown indicates high sediment content.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ulyssys_water_quality_viewer/)
msgstr:
# Ulyssys Water Quality Viewer (UWQV)

Scriptet har til formål dynamisk at visualisere klorofyl- og sedimentforholdene i vandområder, som er primære indikatorer for vandkvalitet. Klorofylindholdet vises i farver fra mørkeblå (lavt klorofylindhold) over grøn til rød (højt klorofylindhold). Sedimentkoncentrationer farves brune; uigennemsigtig brun angiver højt sedimentindhold.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ulyssys_water_quality_viewer/)

# Short wave infrared composite (SWIR)\n.msgid:
# Short wave infrared composite (SWIR)

Short wave infrared (SWIR) measurements can help scientists estimate how much water is present in plants and soil, as water absorbs SWIR wavelengths. Short wave infrared bands (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands) are also useful for distinguishing between cloud types (water clouds versus ice clouds), snow and ice, all of which appear white in visible light. In this composite vegetation appears in shades of green, soils and built-up areas are in various shades of brown, and water appears black. Newly burned land reflects strongly in SWIR bands, making them valuable for mapping fire damages. Each rock type reflects shortwave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/swir-rgb/)
msgstr:
# Kortbølget infrarød komposit (SWIR)

Målinger i kortbølget infrarød (SWIR) kan hjælpe forskere med at vurdere, hvor meget vand der er i planter og jord, da vand absorberer SWIR-bølgelængder. Kortbølgede infrarøde bånd (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd) er også nyttige til at skelne mellem skytyper (vandskyer i forhold til isskyer), sne og is, som alle fremstår hvide i synligt lys. I denne komposit fremstår vegetation i nuancer af grønt, jord og bebyggede områder i forskellige nuancer af brunt, og vand fremstår sort. Nyligt afbrændt land reflekterer kraftigt i SWIR-bånd, hvilket gør dem værdifulde til kortlægning af brandskader. Hver bjergart reflekterer kortbølget infrarødt lys forskelligt, hvilket gør det muligt at kortlægge geologi ved at sammenligne reflekteret SWIR-lys.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/swir-rgb/)

# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI.msgid:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

The Sentinel-2 normalised difference snow index can be used to differentiate between cloud and snow cover as snow absorbs in the short-wave infrared light, but reflects the visible light, whereas cloud is generally reflective in both wavelengths. Snow cover is represented in bright vivid blue.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).
msgstr:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

Sentinel-2's normaliserede differenssneindeks kan bruges til at skelne mellem sky- og snedække, da sne absorberer i det kortbølgede infrarøde lys, men reflekterer det synlige lys, mens skyer generelt er reflekterende i begge bølgelængder. Snedække repræsenteres i klar, levende blå.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).

# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI.msgid:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

The normalised difference snow index (NDSI) can be used to differentiate between cloud and snow cover as snow absorbs in the short-wave infrared light, but reflects the visible light, whereas cloud is generally reflective in both wavelengths. Snow cover is represented in bright vivid blue.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).
msgstr:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

Det normaliserede differenssneindeks (NDSI) kan bruges til at skelne mellem sky- og snedække, da sne absorberer i det kortbølgede infrarøde lys, men reflekterer det synlige lys, mens skyer generelt er reflekterende i begge bølgelængder. Snedække repræsenteres i klar, levende blå.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).

# Highlight Optimized Natural Color\n\nT.msgid:
# Highlight Optimized Natural Color

This script aims to display the Earth in beautiful natural color images. It uses highlight optimization to avoid burnt out pixels and to even out the exposure.



More info [here.](https://sentinel-hub.github.io/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/highlight_optimized_natural_color/#)
msgstr:
# Highlight Optimized Natural Color

Dette script har til formål at vise Jorden i smukke billeder i naturlige farver. Det bruger optimering af højlys for at undgå udbrændte pixels og udjævne eksponeringen.



Mere info [her.](https://sentinel-hub.github.io/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/highlight_optimized_natural_color/#)

# Geology 12, 8, 2 composite\n\nThis com.msgid:
# Geology 12, 8, 2 composite

This composite uses short-wave infrared (SWIR) band 12 to differentiate among different rock types (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Each rock and mineral type reflects short-wave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light. Near infrared (NIR) band 8 highlights vegetation and band 2 detects moisture, both contributing to differentiation of ground materials. The composite is useful for finding geological formations and features (e.g. faults, fractures), lithology (e.g. granite, basalt, etc.) and mining applications.



More info [here.](https://www.euspaceimaging.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/EUSI-SWIR.pdf)
msgstr:
# Geologi 12, 8, 2-komposit

Denne komposit bruger kortbølget infrarødt (SWIR) bånd 12 til at skelne mellem forskellige bjergarter (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd). Hver bjergarts- og mineraltype reflekterer kortbølget infrarødt lys forskelligt, hvilket gør det muligt at kortlægge geologi ved at sammenligne reflekteret SWIR-lys. Nær-infrarødt (NIR) bånd 8 fremhæver vegetation, og bånd 2 registrerer fugt, hvilket begge bidrager til at skelne jordmaterialer. Kompositten er nyttig til at finde geologiske formationer og træk (f.eks. forkastninger, brud), litologi (f.eks. granit, basalt osv.) og til minedrift.



Mere info [her.](https://www.euspaceimaging.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/EUSI-SWIR.pdf)

# Geology 8, 11, 12 composite\n\nThis co.msgid:
# Geology 8, 11, 12 composite

This composite uses both short-wave infrared (SWIR) bands 11 and 12 to differentiate among different rock types (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Each rock and mineral type reflects shortwave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light. Near Infrared (NIR) band 8 highlights vegetation, contributing to differentiation of ground materials. Vegetation in the composite appears red. The composite is useful for differentiating vegetation, and land especially geologic features that can be useful for mining and mineral exploration.



More info [here.](http://murphygeological.com/new---sentinel-2.html#)
msgstr:
# Geologi 8, 11, 12-komposit

Denne komposit bruger både kortbølgede infrarøde (SWIR) bånd 11 og 12 til at skelne mellem forskellige bjergarter (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd). Hver bjergarts- og mineraltype reflekterer kortbølget infrarødt lys forskelligt, hvilket gør det muligt at kortlægge geologi ved at sammenligne reflekteret SWIR-lys. Nær-infrarødt (NIR) bånd 8 fremhæver vegetation, hvilket bidrager til at skelne jordmaterialer. Vegetation fremstår rød i kompositten. Kompositten er nyttig til at skelne vegetation og land, især geologiske træk, der kan være nyttige til minedrift og efterforskning af mineraler.



Mere info [her.](http://murphygeological.com/new---sentinel-2.html#)

# Wildfires\n\nThis script, created by P.msgid:
# Wildfires

This script, created by Pierre Markuse, visualizes wildfires using Sentinel-2 data. It combines natural color background with some NIR/SWIR data for smoke penetration and more detail, while adding highlights from B11 and B12 to show fires in red and orange colors.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/markuse_fire/)
msgstr:
# Skovbrande

Dette script, skabt af Pierre Markuse, visualiserer skovbrande ved hjælp af Sentinel-2-data. Det kombinerer en baggrund i naturlige farver med nogle NIR/SWIR-data for at trænge gennem røg og give flere detaljer, mens det tilføjer højlys fra B11 og B12 for at vise brande i røde og orange farver.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/markuse_fire/)

# Wildfires\n\nThis script, based on the.msgid:
# Wildfires

This script, based on the Pierre Markuse wildfire script, detects and visualizes wildfires using Landsat 8/9 thermal and visible bands. It combines natural color (B2, B3, B4) with thermal band (B10) analysis to detect temperature anomalies and create a red-orange-white glow effect highlighting fire locations.



More info [here.](https://github.com/azlinszkysinergise/customscripts_test_az/blob/main/landsat_markuse_fire_v2)
msgstr:
# Skovbrande

Dette script, baseret på Pierre Markuses skovbrandsscript, registrerer og visualiserer skovbrande ved hjælp af termiske og synlige Landsat 8/9-bånd. Det kombinerer naturlige farver (B2, B3, B4) med analyse af termisk bånd (B10) for at registrere temperaturanomalier og skabe en rød-orange-hvid glødeeffekt, der fremhæver brandenes placering.



Mere info [her.](https://github.com/azlinszkysinergise/customscripts_test_az/blob/main/landsat_markuse_fire_v2)

# Enhanced True Color\n\nThis script, cr.msgid:
# Enhanced True Color

This script, created by Pierre Markuse, uses multiple bands (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands) and saturation and brightness control to enhance the true color visualization.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/enhanced_true_color-2/#)
msgstr:
# Forbedrede naturtro farver

Dette script, skabt af Pierre Markuse, bruger flere bånd (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd) samt kontrol af mætning og lysstyrke til at forbedre visualiseringen i naturtro farver.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/enhanced_true_color-2/#)

# Burned Area Index\n\nBurned Area Index.msgid:
# Burned Area Index

Burned Area Index takes advantage of the wider spectrum of Visible, Red-Edge, NIR and SWIR bands.

Values description:()=> The range of values for the index is `-1` to `1` for burn scars, and `1` - `6` for active fires. Different fire intensities may result in different thresholds; the current values were calibrated, as per original author, on mostly Mediterranen regions.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/bais2/)
msgstr:
# Burned Area Index

Burned Area Index udnytter det bredere spektrum af synlige, red-edge-, NIR- og SWIR-bånd.

Værdibeskrivelse:()=> Indeksets værdiinterval er `-1` til `1` for brandar og `1` - `6` for aktive brande. Forskellige brandintensiteter kan give forskellige tærskler; de nuværende værdier blev ifølge den oprindelige forfatter kalibreret hovedsageligt på middelhavsregioner.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/bais2/)

# Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR)\n\nNormali.msgid:
# Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR)

Normalized Burn Ratio is frequently used to estimate burn severity. It uses near-infrared (NIR) and shortwave-infrared (SWIR) wavelengths. Healthy vegetation has a high reflectance in the near-infrared portion of the spectrum, and a low short-wave infrared reflectance. On the other hand, burned areas have a high shortwave infrared reflectance but low reflectance in the near infrared Darker pixels indicate burned areas.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/nbr/).
msgstr:
# Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR)

Normalized Burn Ratio bruges ofte til at vurdere brandens alvorlighed. Det bruger nær-infrarøde (NIR) og kortbølgede infrarøde (SWIR) bølgelængder. Sund vegetation har en høj reflektans i den nær-infrarøde del af spektret og en lav reflektans i kortbølget infrarødt. Omvendt har afbrændte områder en høj reflektans i kortbølget infrarødt, men lav reflektans i nær-infrarødt. Mørkere pixels angiver afbrændte områder.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/nbr/).

# Atmospheric penetration\n\nThis compos.msgid:
# Atmospheric penetration

This composite uses different bands (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands) in the non-visible part of the electromagnetic spectrum to reduce the influence of the atmosphere in the image. Short wave infrared bands 11 and 12 are highly reflected by the heated areas, making them useful for fire and burned area mapping. Near infrared band 8, is on contrary, highly reflected by vegetation, which signifies absence of fire. Vegetation appears blue, displaying details related to the vegetation vigor. Healthy vegetation is shown in light blue while the stressed, sparse or/and arid vegetation appears in dull blue. Urban features are white, grey, cyan or purple.



More info [here.](https://eos.com/atmospheric-penetration/)
msgstr:
# Atmosfærisk penetration

Denne komposit bruger forskellige bånd (et bånd er et område af det elektromagnetiske spektrum; en satellitsensor kan afbilde Jorden i forskellige bånd) i den ikke-synlige del af det elektromagnetiske spektrum for at reducere atmosfærens indflydelse på billedet. Kortbølgede infrarøde bånd 11 og 12 reflekteres kraftigt af opvarmede områder, hvilket gør dem nyttige til kortlægning af brande og afbrændte områder. Nær-infrarødt bånd 8 reflekteres derimod kraftigt af vegetation, hvilket betyder fravær af brand. Vegetation fremstår blå og viser detaljer relateret til vegetationens vitalitet. Sund vegetation vises i lyseblå, mens stresset, sparsom og/eller tør vegetation fremstår i mat blå. Byelementer er hvide, grå, cyan eller lilla.



Mere info [her.](https://eos.com/atmospheric-penetration/)

# Barren Soil Visualization\n\nThe Barre.msgid:
# Barren Soil Visualization

The Barren Soil Visualization can be useful for soil mapping, to investigate the location of landslides or the extent of erosion in non-vegetated areas. This visualization shows all vegetation in green and the barren ground in red. Water appears black.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/barren_soil/) and [here.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/create-useful-and-beautiful-satellite-images-with-custom-scripts-8ef0e6a474c6)
msgstr:
# Visualisering af bar jord

Visualiseringen af bar jord kan være nyttig til jordkortlægning, til at undersøge placeringen af jordskred eller omfanget af erosion i områder uden vegetation. Denne visualisering viser al vegetation i grønt og den bare jord i rødt. Vand fremstår sort.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/barren_soil/) og [her.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/create-useful-and-beautiful-satellite-images-with-custom-scripts-8ef0e6a474c6)

# True Color with IR Highlights composit.msgid:
# True Color with IR Highlights composite

This composite enhances the true color visualization by adding the shortwave infrared wavelengths to amplify details. It displays heated areas in red/orange.



More info [here.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/active-volcanoes-as-seen-from-space-9d1de0133733)
msgstr:
# Naturtro farver med IR-højlys-komposit

Denne komposit forbedrer visualiseringen i naturtro farver ved at tilføje de kortbølgede infrarøde bølgelængder for at forstærke detaljer. Den viser opvarmede områder i rødt/orange.



Mere info [her.](https://medium.com/sentinel-hub/active-volcanoes-as-seen-from-space-9d1de0133733)

# Detection of Burned Areas\n\nThis scri.msgid:
# Detection of Burned Areas

This script is used to detect large scale recently burned areas. Pixels colored red highlight burned areas, and all other pixels are returned in true color. The script sometimes overestimates burned areas over water and clouds.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/burned_area_ms/)
msgstr:
# Registrering af afbrændte områder

Dette script bruges til at registrere store, nyligt afbrændte områder. Pixels farvet røde fremhæver afbrændte områder, og alle andre pixels returneres i naturtro farver. Scriptet overvurderer nogle gange afbrændte områder over vand og skyer.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/burned_area_ms/)

# Scene classification\n\n\n\nScene clas.msgid:
# Scene classification



Scene classification was developed to distinguish between cloudy pixels, clear pixels and water pixels of Sentinel-2 data and is a result of ESA's Scene classification algorithm. Twelve different classifications are provided including classes of clouds, vegetation, soils/desert, water and snow. It does not constitute a land cover classification map in a strict sense.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/scene-classification/).
msgstr:
# Sceneklassificering



Sceneklassificering blev udviklet til at skelne mellem skyede pixels, klare pixels og vandpixels i Sentinel-2-data og er et resultat af ESA's sceneklassificeringsalgoritme. Der leveres tolv forskellige klassifikationer, herunder klasser for skyer, vegetation, jord/ørken, vand og sne. Det udgør ikke et arealdækkekort i streng forstand.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/scene-classification/).

# Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index (OTCI)\n.msgid:
# Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index (OTCI)



The Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index (OTCI) is estimated based on the chlorophyll content in terrestrial vegetation and can be used to monitor vegetation condition and health. Low OTCI values usually signify water, sand or snow. Extremely high values, displayed with white, usually suggest the absence of chlorophyll as well. They generally represent either bare ground, rock or clouds. The chlorophyll values in between range from red (low chlorophyll values) to dark green (high chlorophyll values) can be used to determine vegetation health.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/otci/)
msgstr:
# Terrestrial Chlorophyll Index (OTCI)



Det terrestriske klorofylindeks (OTCI) estimeres ud fra klorofylindholdet i terrestrisk vegetation og kan bruges til at overvåge vegetationens tilstand og sundhed. Lave OTCI-værdier angiver normalt vand, sand eller sne. Ekstremt høje værdier, vist med hvid, tyder normalt også på fravær af klorofyl. De repræsenterer generelt enten bar jord, klippe eller skyer. Klorofylværdierne derimellem, fra rød (lave klorofylværdier) til mørkegrøn (høje klorofylværdier), kan bruges til at bestemme vegetationens sundhed.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/otci/)

# Topographic Visualization\n\n\n\nThis.msgid:
# Topographic Visualization



This script returns a visualisation with green colours representing lowland elevations and earth colours as mountainous elevations. The script uses discrete classes rather than the continuous visualisations in the other DEM layers.

It is possible to set custom min and max values in the evalscript by setting defaultVis to false and setting the min and max variables to the desired values.



More info [here.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/dem/dem-topographic/)

Det er muligt at angive brugerdefinerede min- og maks-værdier i evalscriptet ved at sætte defaultVis til false og sætte variablerne min og max til de ønskede værdier.



Mere info [her.](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/dem/dem-topographic/)

# Enhanced visualization\n\nThis script.msgid:
# Enhanced visualization

This script combines the gamma0 of the VV and VH polarizations into a false color visualization. It displays water areas in blue (partially black) and land in different shades of yellow/green. Urban areas are displayed in a light green-yellow (towards white), vegetated areas in mustard green and bare ground in a darker green.

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from light green-yellow over brighter green to dark brown or even black. In order not to confuse cryogenic features with non-cryogenic ones, some general information about the location is helpful in interpreting the image.
msgstr:
# Forbedret visualisering

Dette script kombinerer gamma0 for VV- og VH-polariseringerne til en visualisering i falske farver. Det viser vandområder i blåt (delvist sort) og land i forskellige nuancer af gult/grønt. Byområder vises i en lys grøngul farve (mod hvid), beplantede områder i sennepsgrønt og bar jord i en mørkere grøn.

For sne- og isdækkede områder kan visualiseringen variere fra lys grøngul over lysere grøn til mørkebrun eller endda sort. For ikke at forveksle kryogene træk med ikke-kryogene er nogle generelle oplysninger om stedet nyttige ved fortolkning af billedet.

# SAR False Color Visualization\n\nThis.msgid:
# SAR False Color Visualization

This script combines the gamma0 of the VV and VH polarizations of Sentinel-1 SAR data into a false color visualization. Water areas appear in blue (partially black) and land in different shades of yellow/green. Urban areas are displayed in light green-yellow (towards white), vegetated areas in mustard green, and bare ground in darker green. The visualization supports a wide range of monitoring applications, including ice and ship tracking, agriculture and deforestation monitoring, and emergency response scenarios such as flood and volcano observation.

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from light green-yellow over brighter green to dark brown or even black. Some general knowledge of the location is helpful to avoid confusing cryogenic features with other land cover types.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_false_color_visualization/).
msgstr:
# SAR-visualisering i falske farver

Dette script kombinerer gamma0 for VV- og VH-polariseringerne i Sentinel-1 SAR-data til en visualisering i falske farver. Vandområder fremstår i blåt (delvist sort) og land i forskellige nuancer af gult/grønt. Byområder vises i lys grøngul (mod hvid), beplantede områder i sennepsgrønt og bar jord i mørkere grøn. Visualiseringen understøtter en bred vifte af overvågningsanvendelser, herunder sporing af is og skibe, overvågning af landbrug og skovrydning samt nødberedskabsscenarier som observation af oversvømmelser og vulkaner.

For sne- og isdækkede områder kan visualiseringen variere fra lys grøngul over lysere grøn til mørkebrun eller endda sort. Kendskab til stedet er nyttigt for at undgå at forveksle kryogene træk med andre arealdækketyper.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_false_color_visualization/).

# Urban Areas\n\nThis script uses Sentin.msgid:
# Urban Areas

This script uses Sentinel-1 SAR VH and VV polarisations to highlight urban areas and buildings. Structures appear in different colours depending on their backscatter characteristics: purple indicates high VH reflectance, green indicates high VV reflectance, and white indicates high reflectance in both. The red channel is restricted to pixels where VH exceeds 0.5, helping separate buildings from bare soil. The script is useful for monitoring urban expansion, assessing building density, and identifying structures in flood-prone areas. Note that in mountainous terrain, steep slopes and snow can produce similar signals, making it difficult to separate urban areas from other features.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).
msgstr:
# Byområder

Dette script bruger Sentinel-1 SAR VH- og VV-polariseringer til at fremhæve byområder og bygninger. Strukturer fremstår i forskellige farver afhængigt af deres backscatter-egenskaber: lilla angiver høj VH-reflektans, grøn angiver høj VV-reflektans, og hvid angiver høj reflektans i begge. Den røde kanal er begrænset til pixels, hvor VH overstiger 0,5, hvilket hjælper med at adskille bygninger fra bar jord. Scriptet er nyttigt til overvågning af byudvidelse, vurdering af bebyggelsestæthed og identifikation af strukturer i oversvømmelsestruede områder. Bemærk, at i bjergrigt terræn kan stejle skråninger og sne give lignende signaler, hvilket gør det vanskeligt at adskille byområder fra andre træk.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).

# SAR Deforestation Detection\n\nThis sc.msgid:
# SAR Deforestation Detection

This script processes Sentinel-1 VV and VH polarisation bands to detect deforestation and forest degradation. It converts the backscatter values into polar form to derive vector length and angle, which discriminate between water, forest, and bare soil. Water and bare soil appear black, forested areas are rendered in green gradients, and degraded or cleared areas appear in red — with stronger colours indicating higher classification confidence. The script is useful for monitoring forest loss and land-use change over time.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_deforestation_detection/).
msgstr:
# SAR-registrering af skovrydning

Dette script behandler Sentinel-1 VV- og VH-polariseringsbånd for at registrere skovrydning og skovforringelse. Det omregner backscatter-værdierne til polær form for at udlede vektorlængde og vinkel, som skelner mellem vand, skov og bar jord. Vand og bar jord fremstår sorte, skovklædte områder gengives i grønne gradienter, og forringede eller ryddede områder fremstår røde — med stærkere farver, der angiver højere klassificeringssikkerhed. Scriptet er nyttigt til overvågning af skovtab og ændringer i arealanvendelse over tid.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_deforestation_detection/).

# Water Surface Roughness\n\nThis script.msgid:
# Water Surface Roughness

This script visualizes water surface roughness using Sentinel-1 SAR data. SAR backscatter is highly sensitive to the roughness of the water surface: calm water reflects radar energy away from the sensor and appears dark, while rough or wind-driven water scatters energy back and appears brighter. Variations in surface roughness reveal oceanographic and maritime features such as wind patterns, sea currents, internal waves, and ship wakes. Oil spills dampen surface waves and appear as dark patches against the surrounding rougher water. The visualization supports maritime monitoring applications including ship tracking, oil pollution detection, and observation of ocean circulation.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/water_surface_roughness_visualization/).
msgstr:
# Vandoverfladens ruhed

Dette script visualiserer vandoverfladens ruhed ved hjælp af Sentinel-1 SAR-data. SAR-backscatter er meget følsom over for vandoverfladens ruhed: roligt vand reflekterer radarenergi væk fra sensoren og fremstår mørkt, mens oprørt eller vinddrevet vand spreder energi tilbage og fremstår lysere. Variationer i overfladens ruhed afslører oceanografiske og maritime træk såsom vindmønstre, havstrømme, interne bølger og skibsbølger. Olieudslip dæmper overfladebølger og fremstår som mørke pletter mod det omgivende ruere vand. Visualiseringen understøtter maritime overvågningsanvendelser, herunder sporing af skibe, registrering af olieforurening og observation af havcirkulation.



Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/water_surface_roughness_visualization/).

# RGB ratio\n\nThis script combines the.msgid:
# RGB ratio

This script combines the gamma0 of the VV and VH polarizations into a false color visualization. It uses the VV polarization in the red channel, the VH polarization in the green channel, and a ratio of VH/VV in the blue channel. It shows water areas in dark red (black), urban areas in yellow, vegetated areas in turquoise, and bare ground in dark purple.

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from light yellow to blue to red. In order not to confuse cryogenic features with non-cryogenic ones, some general information about the location is helpful in interpreting the image.
msgstr:
# RGB-forhold

Dette script kombinerer gamma0 for VV- og VH-polariseringerne til en visualisering i falske farver. Det bruger VV-polariseringen i den røde kanal, VH-polariseringen i den grønne kanal og et forhold mellem VH/VV i den blå kanal. Det viser vandområder i mørkerød (sort), byområder i gult, beplantede områder i turkis og bar jord i mørk lilla.

For sne- og isdækkede områder kan visualiseringen variere fra lysegul til blå til rød. For ikke at forveksle kryogene træk med ikke-kryogene er nogle generelle oplysninger om stedet nyttige ved fortolkning af billedet.

# SAR Urban\n\nThe script is useful for.msgid:
# SAR Urban

The script is useful for locating urban areas and individual buildings. It uses the gamma0 of the VH polarization and the VV polarizations to highlight different buildings and topology orientations with purple and green colors. It can be used to track urban expansion, estimate building type, or locate buildings in risk areas (e.g., flooding).

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from white to purple to dark blue or even black. In order not to confuse cryogenic features with non-cryogenic ones, some general information about the location is helpful to interpret the image. 

More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).
msgstr:
# SAR byområder

Scriptet er nyttigt til at lokalisere byområder og enkelte bygninger. Det bruger gamma0 for VH-polariseringen og VV-polariseringerne til at fremhæve forskellige bygninger og topologiorienteringer med lilla og grønne farver. Det kan bruges til at følge byudvidelse, vurdere bygningstype eller lokalisere bygninger i risikoområder (f.eks. oversvømmelse).

For sne- og isdækkede områder kan visualiseringen variere fra hvid til lilla til mørkeblå eller endda sort. For ikke at forveksle kryogene træk med ikke-kryogene er nogle generelle oplysninger om stedet nyttige til at fortolke billedet. 

Mere info [her](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).

# HH - decibel gamma0\n\nThis script dis.msgid:
# HH - decibel gamma0

This script displays a grayscale visualization of the gamma0 of the HH polarization. The HH polarization is less sensitive to surface roughness compared to the VV polarization and is therefore used for detecting objects and hard targets such as ships. It provides good contrast between water and land surfaces. Compared to the linear gamma0 visualization, the decibel gamma0 visualization includes a logarithmic scaling of the data.

Den giver god kontrast mellem vand- og landoverflader. Sammenlignet med den lineære gamma0-visualisering omfatter decibel-gamma0-visualiseringen en logaritmisk skalering af dataene.

# Total suspended matter concentration\n.msgid:
# Total suspended matter concentration

Satellite-derived total suspended matter (TSM) is a measure of the concentration of particulate material in surface water such as mud, silt and other fine-grainded sedimentss, including organic and inorganic fractions. The TSM product is calculated based on the MERIS 1999 Baseline Atmospheric Correction and the OCI neural net TSM algorithm by [Hieronymi et al. 2017](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2017.00140/full). The product has variable accuracy and schould be considert experimental.

More info [here.](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel3.html#sentinel-3-olci-level-2)
msgstr:
# Koncentration af total suspenderet stof

Satellitebaseret total suspenderet stof (TSM) er et mål for koncentrationen af partikulært materiale i overfladevand, såsom mudder, silt og andre finkornede sedimenter, herunder organiske og uorganiske fraktioner. TSM-produktet beregnes på grundlag af MERIS 1999 Baseline Atmospheric Correction og OCI-neuralnetværksalgoritmen for TSM af [Hieronymi et al. 2017](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2017.00140/full). Produktet har varierende nøjagtighed og bør betragtes som eksperimentelt.

Mere info [her.](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel3.html#sentinel-3-olci-level-2)

# Aerosol optical thickness\n\nAerosol o.msgid:
# Aerosol optical thickness

Aerosol optical thickness (AOT) is a measure of the extent to which aerosols in the atmosphere prevent the transmission of light through absorption and scattering. Optical thickness, also knwon as optical depth depends on the physical nature, the shape and the concentration of particles. AOT is often used in climatology and atmospheric research to assess the effects of aerosols on weather, climate, and air quality.

More info [here.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)
msgstr:
# Aerosols optiske tykkelse

Aerosols optiske tykkelse (AOT) er et mål for, i hvilket omfang aerosoler i atmosfæren forhindrer lysets transmission gennem absorption og spredning. Optisk tykkelse, også kendt som optisk dybde, afhænger af partiklernes fysiske natur, form og koncentration. AOT bruges ofte i klimatologi og atmosfæreforskning til at vurdere aerosolers indvirkning på vejr, klima og luftkvalitet.

Mere info [her.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)

# Photosynthetically active radiation\n\.msgid:
# Photosynthetically active radiation

The Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) visualization displays the instantaneous PAR at the water surface. It was adopted from FERIS and developed based on an algorithm by [Aiken and Moore (1997)](https://earth.esa.int/eogateway/documents/20142/37627/MERIS_ATBD_2.18_v4.0+-+1997+-+PAR.pdf/07a8cd54-94ba-4efe-fe9a-751d1ffc9381). The PAR is a measure of the energy flux from the sun in the wavelenght range of 400–700 nm. It is often used to convert measured chlorophyll concentration into an estimate of ocen productivity and from this an estimate of the carbon sequestration. As such, it plays an important role in modelling of the carbon-cycle.

More info [here](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).
msgstr:
# Fotosyntetisk aktiv stråling

Visualiseringen af fotosyntetisk aktiv stråling (PAR) viser den øjeblikkelige PAR ved vandoverfladen. Den er overtaget fra FERIS og udviklet på grundlag af en algoritme af [Aiken og Moore (1997)](https://earth.esa.int/eogateway/documents/20142/37627/MERIS_ATBD_2.18_v4.0+-+1997+-+PAR.pdf/07a8cd54-94ba-4efe-fe9a-751d1ffc9381). PAR er et mål for energifluxen fra solen i bølgelængdeområdet 400–700 nm. Den bruges ofte til at omregne målt klorofylkoncentration til et estimat af havets produktivitet og ud fra det et estimat af kulstofbindingen. Som sådan spiller den en vigtig rolle i modellering af kulstofkredsløbet.

Mere info [her](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).

# Diffuse attenuation coefficient\n\nThe.msgid:
# Diffuse attenuation coefficient

The diffuse attenuation coefficient at 490 nm is a measure of how the intensity of light decreases as it passes through a column of water. It quantifies the rate at which light is absorbed and scattered by water and its constituents, such as phytoplankton, dissolved organic matter and suspended particles. This coefficient is crucial for understanding underwater light environments and is widely used in marine biology, oceanography and environmental science. It's calculated as described in [Morel et al. (2007)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0034425707001307).

More info [here](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).
msgstr:
# Diffus dæmpningskoefficient

Den diffuse dæmpningskoefficient ved 490 nm er et mål for, hvordan lysets intensitet aftager, når det passerer gennem en vandsøjle. Den kvantificerer den hastighed, hvormed lys absorberes og spredes af vand og dets bestanddele, såsom fytoplankton, opløst organisk stof og suspenderede partikler. Denne koefficient er afgørende for forståelsen af lysforholdene under vand og bruges bredt inden for marinbiologi, oceanografi og miljøvidenskab. Den beregnes som beskrevet i [Morel et al. (2007)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0034425707001307).

Mere info [her](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data).

# Integrated water vapour column\n\nThe.msgid:
# Integrated water vapour column

The integrated water vapour column displays the water vapour integrated over an atmosphere column. It is displayed in kg/m2 and calculated on the basis of band 18 (885 nm) and band 19 (900 nm). The product shows an overestimation in the transition zones between glint and off-glint and has a systematic overestimation of about 20%.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-IntegratedWaterVapourColumnoverLandS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-IWV).
msgstr:
# Integreret vanddampsøjle

Den integrerede vanddampsøjle viser vanddampen integreret over en atmosfæresøjle. Den vises i kg/m2 og beregnes på grundlag af bånd 18 (885 nm) og bånd 19 (900 nm). Produktet viser en overvurdering i overgangszonerne mellem glint og off-glint og har en systematisk overvurdering på omkring 20 %.

Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-IntegratedWaterVapourColumnoverLandS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-IWV).

# CDM absorption coefficient\n\nThe Colo.msgid:
# CDM absorption coefficient

The Coloured Detrital and Dissolved Material (CDM) absorption coefficient at 443 nm indicates the fraction of incident light that is absorbed by both detrital particles and colored dissolved organic matter (CDOM). Dissolved organic matter is an important component of the oceanic carbon cycle. It is also used as an indicator for assessing the impact of terrigenous inputs in coastal waters.

More info [here](https://data.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset/b2c93f4d-7d90-448f-a6f4-62f78e3b673b).
msgstr:
# CDM-absorptionskoefficient

Absorptionskoefficienten for Coloured Detrital and Dissolved Material (CDM) ved 443 nm angiver den andel af det indfaldende lys, der absorberes af både detritale partikler og farvet opløst organisk stof (CDOM). Opløst organisk stof er en vigtig komponent i havets kulstofkredsløb. Det bruges også som indikator til vurdering af virkningen af terrigene tilførsler i kystvande.

Mere info [her](https://data.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset/b2c93f4d-7d90-448f-a6f4-62f78e3b673b).

# Aerosol Angstrom exponent\n\nThe Aeros.msgid:
# Aerosol Angstrom exponent

The Aerosol Angstrom exponent is a parameter that describes how the optical thickness of aerosols in the atmosphere varies with wavelength. It provides information about the size distribution of aerosol particles, with higher values indicating smaller particles and lower values indicating larger particles. This exponent is often used in atmospheric research and climatology to analyse the properties of aerosols and their effects on climate and air quality.

More info [here.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)
msgstr:
# Aerosols Ångström-eksponent

Aerosols Ångström-eksponent er en parameter, der beskriver, hvordan den optiske tykkelse af aerosoler i atmosfæren varierer med bølgelængden. Den giver oplysninger om størrelsesfordelingen af aerosolpartikler, hvor højere værdier angiver mindre partikler og lavere værdier angiver større partikler. Denne eksponent bruges ofte i atmosfæreforskning og klimatologi til at analysere aerosolers egenskaber og deres indvirkning på klima og luftkvalitet.

Mere info [her.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)

# Rectified reflectance 779\n\nThe recti.msgid:
# Rectified reflectance 779

The rectified reflectance product is a by-product of the GIFAPAR product. It shows a virtual reflectance that is largely free of atmospheric and angular effects and is a good approcimation of the top of the canopy reflectances. The rectified reflectance 779 is based on the NIR band (band 17) with a wavelength of 779 nm.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-RectifiedReflectanceS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-RC).
msgstr:
# Korrigeret reflektans 779

Produktet for korrigeret reflektans er et biprodukt af GIFAPAR-produktet. Det viser en virtuel reflektans, der i vid udstrækning er fri for atmosfæriske og vinkelmæssige effekter, og som er en god tilnærmelse til reflektansen i toppen af kronedækket. Den korrigerede reflektans 779 er baseret på NIR-båndet (bånd 17) med en bølgelængde på 779 nm.

Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-RectifiedReflectanceS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-RC).

# Rectified reflectance 681\n\nThe recti.msgid:
# Rectified reflectance 681

The rectified reflectance product is a by-product of the GIFAPAR product. It shows a virtual reflectance that is largely free of atmospheric and angular effects and is a good approcimation of the top of the canopy reflectances. The rectified reflectance 681 is based on the red band (band 10) with a wavelength of 681 nm.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-RectifiedReflectanceS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-RC).

Den korrigerede reflektans 681 er baseret på det røde bånd (bånd 10) med en bølgelængde på 681 nm.

Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-RectifiedReflectanceS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-RC).

# Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorb.msgid:
# Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Available Radiation (GIFAPAR)

The Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Available Radiation (GIFAPAR) is a bio-geophysical product used to study the photosynthetic process of plants and is often used in diagnostic and predictive models computing primary productivity of the vegetation canopies. In addition, this parameter is also an input for the estimation of assimilation of CO2 in vegetation. GIFAPAR ranges from 0–1.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-GreenInstantaneousFractionofAbsorbedPhotosyntheticallyActiveRadiation(GI-FAPAR)S3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-GI-FAPAR).
msgstr:
# Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Available Radiation (GIFAPAR)

Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Available Radiation (GIFAPAR) er et biogeofysisk produkt, der bruges til at studere planters fotosyntese, og som ofte anvendes i diagnostiske og prædiktive modeller, der beregner den primære produktivitet i vegetationens kronedække. Desuden er denne parameter et input til estimeringen af CO2-assimilation i vegetation. GIFAPAR ligger mellem 0 og 1.

Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-GreenInstantaneousFractionofAbsorbedPhotosyntheticallyActiveRadiation(GI-FAPAR)S3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-GI-FAPAR).

# Integrated water vapour column\n\nThe.msgid:
# Integrated water vapour column

The integrated water vapour column displays the water vapour integrated over an atmosphere column. It is displayed in kg/m2 and calculated on the basis of band 18 (885 nm) and band 19 (900 nm). The product provides stable and high quality results, but shows a systematic overestimation of about 9%–13% copared to ground base reference.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-IntegratedWaterVapourColumnoverLandS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-IWV).
msgstr:
# Integreret vanddampsøjle

Den integrerede vanddampsøjle viser vanddampen integreret over en atmosfæresøjle. Den vises i kg/m2 og beregnes på grundlag af bånd 18 (885 nm) og bånd 19 (900 nm). Produktet giver stabile resultater af høj kvalitet, men viser en systematisk overvurdering på omkring 9 %–13 % sammenlignet med jordbaseret reference.

Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-IntegratedWaterVapourColumnoverLandS3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-IWV).

# Land Surface Temperature (LST)\n\nThe.msgid:
# Land Surface Temperature (LST)

The Land Surface Temperature (LST) product provides the temperature of the Earth's surface as retrieved from the SLSTR thermal infrared channels. LST is a key parameter in the physics of land surface, controlling the partitioning of energy between the atmosphere and the land surface. It is used in climate change monitoring, drought monitoring, and urban heat island studies.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#S3-SLSTR-Products-L2-LST-Products).
msgstr:
# Landoverfladetemperatur (LST)

Produktet for landoverfladetemperatur (LST) angiver temperaturen på Jordens overflade, udledt af SLSTR's termiske infrarøde kanaler. LST er en nøgleparameter i landoverfladens fysik og styrer fordelingen af energi mellem atmosfæren og landoverfladen. Den bruges til overvågning af klimaændringer, tørkeovervågning og undersøgelser af bymæssige varmeøer.

Mere info [her](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#S3-SLSTR-Products-L2-LST-Products).

# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

The Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) is a dimensionless index that describes the difference between visible and near-infrared reflectance of vegetation cover. It can be used to estimate the density of vegetation cover and monitor vegetation health.

More info [here](https://github.com/eu-cdse/sentinel-hub-custom-scripts/tree/main/sentinel-3/slstrl2/ndvi/).
msgstr:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) er et dimensionsløst indeks, der beskriver forskellen mellem vegetationsdækkets synlige og nær-infrarøde reflektans. Det kan bruges til at estimere vegetationsdækkets tæthed og overvåge vegetationens sundhed.

Mere info [her](https://github.com/eu-cdse/sentinel-hub-custom-scripts/tree/main/sentinel-3/slstrl2/ndvi/).

The Normalized Difference Vegetation Ind.msgid: The Normalized Difference Vegetation Index is a spectral index indicating the greenness of the vegetation.
msgstr: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index er et spektralt indeks, der angiver vegetationens grønhed.
